prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: one tightly cropped dialogue portrait for a grounded medieval RPG.
Input images: Image 1 is this character's existing identity and clothing palette ONLY; Images 2 through 5 are approved Mara, Ivo, Leiya and Tor portrait STYLE references. Match the latter four's sober facial anatomy, very tight scale, deliberate hard pixel clusters and stepped edges. Do not copy their identities. Do not carry forward Image 1's chibi oversize eyes or full-body framing.
Primary request: substantially redraw the identity as a 74 pixels wide by 100 pixels high dialogue portrait. Compose deliberately on those coarse logical pixels. A larger renderer output must look like uniform nearest-neighbor enlargement of that coarse grid; no high-frequency painted detail awaiting downsampling.
Subject: Leo Kays, 雷奥·凯斯, NPC-REY. A mature adult man retaining the old identity's dark brown short slightly tousled side-swept hair, a few broad matte locks, light grey eyes, straight substantial nose and short dark stubble. Adult firm jaw and brow ridge; face broader and fuller than thin grey-haired Hers, with clear cheekbone and nose-wing planes. Stubble remains a restrained connected dark jaw shadow with no full long beard and no scattered dots. Naturally small deep-set eyes looking slightly toward viewer-left, steady brows with a subtle single inward bend, closed even mouth. Expression: cautious firm scrutiny, responsible but prepared to question evidence, not cruel, furious, smug, youthful or heroic smiling. No glossy eye glints and no large white eye blocks. Preserve mature masculine identity and warm matte terracotta skin.
Bottom costume sliver only: plain dark worn steel neck guard over faded muted blue cloth, a tiny brown travel strap at one bottom corner if it fits. Blue-steel-brown identity palette. No crown, commander emblem, new weapon, heraldry, political alliance tokens, or chest display. He is a local quartermaster/sealing envoy; do not visually imply supreme rank or a concluded story choice. No sealing box or props within portrait.
Framing: EXTREME CLOSE head. Entire crown barely inside top edge, cheeks occupy nearly all usable width, jaw/chin down near the bottom. Almost no neck; only a tiny collar sliver along the bottom edge. No shoulders or chest expanse. Match the approved portraits' tightly filled framing and asymmetrical natural three-quarter anatomy.
Medium: hard-edged low-resolution pixel portrait, strong warm near-black outer contour, opaque grouped color areas, large contiguous facial clusters, purposeful stair-stepped edges. 32 or fewer visible working colors in this batch. Warm matte highlights, compact brown shadow planes, crisp nostril and cheekbone boundaries. Hair and stubble use only a few broad connected masses. No gradients, antialiasing, grain, dithering, airbrush, painterly softness, fine single hair strands, scratchy hatching, isolated glitter pixels, doll eyes or smooth anime face.
True transparent alpha outside silhouette. One person, one head, no text, border, background, panels, UI, props or hands.
